General information, not legal or tax advice. Rules in this area are changing quickly; check the current position before you order.

## Torso vs Full-Size Doll: The Honest Trade-Off
URL: https://thedollscout.com/guides/torso-vs-full-size

Guides / Torso vs Full-Size
Torso vs full-size: the honest trade-off
Shops push full-size dolls because they cost four times as much. Torso sellers push torsos. Here is the comparison neither of them will write.
The decision rule: a full-size doll is 55–100+ lb of dead weight you will move repeatedly, for years. Not once at delivery — every time you clean it, reposition it, or put it away. If you cannot say honestly that you will keep doing that in year three, buy a torso. If full-body presence is the entire point for you, a torso will disappoint and saving money will not fix that.
The head-to-head
Torso Full-size
Weight 13–30 lb for most — liftable one-handed. Large 140 cm-class torsos reach 60+ lb 55–100+ lb, unbalanced and limp
Typical price $150–$700 $800–$1,800 TPE · $1,800–$3,500 silicone
Storage A drawer or a small lockable case Hanging kit on a reinforced rod, or a flight case ($120–$700)
Cleaning Carry it to the bathroom The doll does not come to you; this is the chore people underestimate
First-year extras $45–$75 in care supplies ~$140 TPE / ~$60 silicone, plus storage and a repair kit
Discretion High — nothing visible, parcel-sized delivery A five-foot crate arrives at your door
Posing and dressing None The main reason to pay four times more
If you stop using it You are out a few hundred dollars You own a heavy object you cannot easily resell or discard — and discarding one badly has closed roads
What does a torso actually give up?
We recommend torsos often, so it matters that this list is complete rather than flattering:
No presence. A full body in a room is a different experience from an object in a drawer, and for many owners that difference is the whole purchase. No specification sheet captures it.
No posing, no dressing. A large part of what long-term owners actually enjoy — photography, outfits, arranging — needs limbs and a skeleton.
Fewer positions. Straightforwardly narrower.
No face. Most torsos have no head. If the face is what you are choosing between listings, you are not shopping for a torso.
Weaker resale. Thin second-hand market either way, but a torso is worth little.
What it does not give up is material quality. A good torso is the same TPE or silicone as a good doll, from the same factories. "Cheaper" here means less of it, not worse of it — and the 50%-off rule applies exactly the same way.
What do the numbers do to the decision?
Run both through the True Cost Calculator and the gap widens past the sticker price, because the costs a torso avoids are the recurring ones. No storage build-out. No repair reserve for tears at stress points. Less consumable care. A $400 torso is close to a $450 first year. A $1,500 TPE doll is closer to $2,000 once duty, storage, care and a repair kit are in.
The other number worth sitting with: a torso is roughly one-fifth of the weight, one-fifth of the price, and one-fifth of the storage problem. Whether it delivers anything like a proportional share of the experience is a judgement, not a measurement, and it depends entirely on which of the things above you actually wanted.
Who should buy a torso, and who should buy full-size?
Buy a torso if you live with people, share a small space, are unsure whether you will still want this in a year, cannot comfortably carry 60 lb up your own stairs, or your honest all-in budget is under about $800.
Buy compact (roughly 140–155 cm, 50–60 lb, $600–$1,300) if you want the full form but were truthful about the lifting. This middle option is the one shops surface least, because it sits between two things they would rather sell.
Buy full-size if presence, posing or dressing is the actual reason you are buying, you have private storage that can take the weight, and the all-in total does not strain the budget. Going full-size on a stretched budget is how people end up with a doll from a shop that should have failed the ten checks .
Can you start with a torso and upgrade later?
Nothing carries over. A torso is not a deposit on a future doll, and anyone implying otherwise is selling. What it buys you is information: how the material actually feels to you, how much cleaning you will really tolerate, whether the storage plan you imagined survives contact with your actual home.
Three hundred dollars spent learning that is cheap against a two-thousand-dollar mistake — and the two-thousand-dollar mistake is common enough that "it ended up in the closet" is one of the most repeated stories in owner communities.
Where to look, once you've decided
These open the matching category at YourDoll, the one vendor on our vetted list . Ordered the way this page argues, not by price.
Torsos →
Compact & full-size TPE →
Full-size silicone →
Check the stated height before the photo. Listings put the render first and the specification underneath, which is the wrong order for this decision — height is the one number that predicts whether you will still be using it in a year. We earn a commission on these links, and it is worth saying that it is smaller on a torso than on a full-size doll. That is exactly why the torso is listed first.
Common questions
Is a torso worth it? For most first-time buyers, yes — on the specific grounds of weight, storage and reversibility, not because it is a smaller version of the same thing. It is a different product.
How much does a torso weigh? 13–30 lb for most, by our collected data — but large 140 cm-class torsos reach 60+ lb, so check the stated weight, not the category name. That single fact is the entire argument for one.
Can I upgrade later? Yes, and it is the normal path. Nothing transfers physically; what transfers is knowing your own preferences before you spend four figures.
Whichever you choose, the shop matters more than the product. Run the 10-point Scam-Check , pay with PayPal or a credit card, and require factory photos of your actual item before dispatch.

## TPE or silicone: which sex doll material should you buy?
URL: https://thedollscout.com/guides/tpe-vs-silicone

Guides / TPE vs Silicone
TPE vs Silicone: the honest comparison
The industry's most-asked question, answered without a sales agenda.
The one-question decision rule: "Will I actually spend 15–30 minutes cleaning and drying after each use — in year three?" If yes — TPE gives you the softest feel for hundreds less. If you're honest with yourself and the answer is no — buy silicone or don't buy at all. An unmaintained TPE doll degrades, stains and can grow mold.
How do TPE and silicone compare, side by side?
TPE Silicone (platinum-cure)
Feel Softer, more jiggle, more flexible Firmer; premium lines are close but not equal
Realism of detail Good Best — fine skin texture, makeup holds for years
Hygiene Porous — can't be fully sterilized; must dry thoroughly Non-porous — easy to clean properly
Maintenance 15–30 min clean-and-dry after each use, + monthly powdering + periodic mineral oil 15–30 min clean after each use, + occasional powder. No oiling.
Durability Tears and stains easier; dye transfer from dark clothing Highly resistant; longest lifespan
Heat tolerance Poor — deforms near heaters, hot cars Good
Typical full-size price $800–$1,800 $1,800–$3,500
Hidden costs (year 1) ~$180 care + repair kit ~$60 care
Best for Budget-conscious buyers who'll do the routine Low-maintenance owners, longest-term value
What do shops not tell you about each material?
Cost per year beats sticker price. A $2,400 silicone doll kept 6 years costs less per year than a $1,200 TPE doll that degrades in 3. Run your numbers in the True Cost Calculator .
Hybrids exist and are a smart middle path: silicone head (durable makeup, best facial realism) on a TPE body (soft, cheaper). Many factories offer this configuration.
"Silicone" under ~$1,000 full-size is a red flag. Real platinum silicone is expensive raw material. Impossible prices mean TPE mislabeled as silicone — or a counterfeit shop .
Weight is similar in both materials — material choice won't save you from the weight problem. A full-size doll is 55–100+ lb either way; if that's a concern, consider a torso or compact build first.
Which one should you actually choose?
First doll, budget under $1,500: compact TPE from a verified factory brand — or a premium torso to learn your preferences cheaply.
Budget $1,800+, or you hate maintenance: full silicone.
Best facial realism on a budget: hybrid (silicone head + TPE body).

What we'd tell a friend: filter by material on the vendor's own listing rather than trusting the product title — "silicone" in a name sometimes means a silicone head on a TPE body. If a full-size doll is listed as silicone under about $1,000, the label is wrong regardless of who is selling it. We earn a commission on these links; it does not change which material we told you to buy.
Whatever material you choose: buy only from a vendor that passes the 10-point Scam-Check , pay with PayPal or credit card, and require factory photos of your doll before dispatch.

## Sex Doll Prices: What 50 Live Listings Actually Show
URL: https://thedollscout.com/guides/what-a-doll-costs

Guides / What a doll costs
What a doll actually costs — from 50 live listings, and one claim we had to withdraw
Last updated 11 August 2026 · every number sourced, or marked unverified
Every price guide in this category gives a range like "$100 to
$10,000", which is true and useless. We record the price, height and weight of
every doll our scraper can reach at a vetted vendor, and band what comes back.
We have now done it twice. The second time contradicted the first, so this page
leads with that.
We were wrong, and here is the correction. On 27 July 2026 we
recorded 33 full-size listings, found the cheapest at $1,099, and wrote that
no full-size doll costs under $1,000 . On 11 August 2026 the same
scraper reached 50 full-size listings and found two at $899 —
the same 150 cm F-cup TPE model, held in US warehouse stock. The claim
was true of what we had seen and false of the market. It is withdrawn.
What survives is the part that matters: the real floor is
around $899, and the "$299 full-size premium doll" you saw advertised is
still nowhere near it.
The bands, from the 11 August 2026 data

The rows are published: download the dataset
as JSON or CSV (CC BY 4.0) and check these bands yourself.
Recorded 2026-08-11 from live product pages at one vetted vendor
(yourdoll.com, 53 rows in total — 50 full-size and 3 partial bodies), 100% of visited product pages rendered; vendor-stated figures,
not independently weighed; sale prices as shown that day. No rows were dropped from this recording. The 7 August one dropped two, where a 160 cm doll came back at 2.5 kg — a shipping or head weight
the parser mistook for a body weight, and the kind of error that survives every
check a missing value would have failed. An earlier run dropped a $129 row that
turned out to be a hoodie carrying the spec table of the doll it fits. Method
and the full height/weight table: the weight
chart .
Why we published the correction instead of the better number
The 27 July figure was not a lie and it was not a mistake in arithmetic. It
was a claim about a market made from a sample of one vendor's catalogue on one
day, and it did not survive contact with a second day. Almost every guide in
this category would have quietly updated the number, or simply left the older,
tidier claim standing.
We publish the dataset, so leaving it standing was never available to us —
and that is the entire argument for publishing the dataset. A number
you cannot check is a number you have to trust; a number you can check is one
we cannot quietly move. Both recording dates are kept, and the prices
on this page carry the date they were seen, because a price without a date is
not evidence about anything.
Why the empty band matters more than the full ones
Factories set minimum pricing, and legitimate vendors sit roughly 10–15%
below factory list. That is why the space between "torso money" and "$1,099"
contains nothing at a vetted shop — the economics of licensed manufacture do not
reach there. But marketplace and social-media listings advertise that band
heavily, because it is exactly where an impulse purchase lives: enough to feel
premium, little enough to skip the research.
What ships from that band, when anything ships at all, is a counterfeit cast
from stolen photos, or an inflatable product photographed as a premium doll.
This is not an inference from pricing theory; it is a recurring pattern in
documented buyer complaints — the same reports our
Scam-Check was built from. If a listing claims
full-size under $1,000, run it through the 10-point
Scam-Check before paying — and if it fails, the answer was free.
The sticker is not the cost
Whatever band you buy in, the first year adds to it. Care supplies run
differently by material (TPE needs more), storage is real money if you do it
properly, and import charges depend entirely on your country — the US currently
has no duty-free allowance at all ,
and nobody can honestly quote a US duty rate for a full-size doll
because the tariff classification is unsettled. Put your own numbers into the
True Cost Calculator ; it keeps them in your
browser.
And before any money moves: how you pay decides what recourse you
keep . A credit card can carry statutory protection a bank transfer
never will — the payment recourse checker
covers what survives after payment, with no affiliate links on that page.

# Import rules by country

## Sex Doll Import Rules by Country: Legality & Duty
URL: https://thedollscout.com/importing/

Importing an adult doll, by country
The question buyers ask after they've paid, when they should ask it before. General information, not legal advice — verify current rules with your own customs authority.
Destination Short answer
Australia Adult-form dolls legal to import. Childlike dolls carry up to 15 years — enforcement is active and aggressive.
New Zealand Lawful in principle, but the seizure standard is broader and vaguer than Australia's — read before ordering.
United States No federal ban on adult-form dolls — but the $800 duty-free allowance every other guide still quotes was abolished in August 2025.
Canada Legal unless classified as obscene under Tariff Item 9899.00.00 — and the CAD 20 threshold that guides routinely miss means China-origin shipments are always taxable.
United Kingdom No prohibition identified on adult-form dolls. Importing a childlike doll is prosecuted — though simple possession is still not an offence.
Germany Adult-form dolls fine. Childlike dolls are criminal to merely possess — and the €150 duty-free threshold was abolished on 1 July 2026.
Japan Legal, and the home of the industry's premium manufacturers — but Japan is the one country where childlike dolls are also legal, which is a trap for foreign buyers.
South Korea Legal since the customs guideline of December 2022, reaffirmed by the Supreme Court in April 2026 — after years of seizures and litigation.
Singapore Not on any prohibited list and no statute bans it — but an officer can still classify it as an obscene article. A grey zone, not a safe harbour.
Malaysia Treat as prohibited. Enforcement is active and seizures are routine — our advice is not to attempt import.
Thailand Illegal to import, with real criminal exposure. Open sale in local markets gives a false sense of safety — the border is the chokepoint.
Universal prohibition: every jurisdiction covered here bans childlike dolls, several with specific criminal statutes. DollScout exclusively covers adult-form products and reports vendors that stock anything otherwise.

## Is it legal to import a sex doll into Australia?
URL: https://thedollscout.com/importing/australia

Importing / Australia
Is it legal to import an adult doll into Australia?
Adult-form dolls legal to import. Childlike dolls carry up to 15 years — enforcement is active and aggressive. Duty and import-tax treatment is set out below with its source. Childlike dolls are prohibited regardless, with serious criminal penalties. Verify with customs in Australia before ordering; this is not legal advice.
General information for adult buyers, not legal advice. Rules change — verify current requirements with Australia customs before ordering.
Status: Adult-form dolls are legal for an adult to import into Australia. There is no Commonwealth ban on adult dolls as a category, and every enforcement action we could find concerned childlike dolls, not adult ones. The prohibition is defined by the apparent age of the figure, not by the product type.
What will you pay in tax and duty?
GST is 10%. The low-value threshold is AUD 1,000 per consignment, measured on customs value excluding shipping and insurance. At or below that, registered overseas sellers charge GST at checkout; above it, the Australian Border Force assesses GST — and any duty — at the border before the goods are released. Most full-size dolls sit above AUD 1,000, so expect border assessment rather than checkout GST. The threshold is not a tax-free allowance, it only decides who collects. We could not confirm the specific tariff classification for dolls, so treat any single duty percentage you are quoted as unverified until you check the ABF tariff.
What does customs actually do with these shipments?
The ABF runs intelligence-led targeting for childlike dolls across sea, air and mail cargo, and its published enforcement pattern is worth understanding before you order: an interception is frequently followed by a search warrant at the buyer's home and seizure of phones and computers, which can produce further charges. In other words, the downside of a wrong purchase here is not a lost parcel. Adult-form dolls are not treated as objectionable goods as a class, and we found no enforcement action against one.
What is prohibited regardless of anything else?
Criminal, and prosecuted. Possession of a childlike doll is an offence under section 273A.1 of the Criminal Code, inserted by the Combatting Child Sexual Exploitation Legislation Amendment Act 2019 and applying from 21 September 2019, carrying a maximum of 15 years. Importation is charged under the Customs Act 1901, carrying up to 10 years plus a substantial fine. South Australia has its own separate offence. The test is whether a reasonable person would consider the object resembles a person under 18 — a question about appearance, decided by a court.
DollScout exclusively covers adult-form products. We refuse to review, link to, or earn commission on any product with a childlike appearance, and we drop vendors that stock them.
Practical notes for buyers
Height is the single biggest trigger, and there is no safe-harbour number. The statutory test is about apparent age, not centimetres. A reported ACT case involved a doll of roughly 100 cm bought by a man who said he wanted an ordinary adult doll and had not read the measurements; he was ultimately acquitted, but only after two criminal trials spanning about 21 months.
Petite and small-bust adult dolls attract disproportionate scrutiny , because shipping dolls in parts and labelling them as "petite adult figures" are known evasion tactics. That has poisoned the well for legitimate buyers of small adult builds. If you want a compact doll, favour clearly adult proportions and keep the vendor's specification sheet.
A vendor's "adult" label is not a defence. Apparent age is assessed on the object itself, not on the listing text.
Never let a vendor ship a doll in parts to avoid detection. In at least one prosecution, part-shipping was treated as evidence of consciousness of guilt at sentencing.
Declare accurately. A vague or false declaration turns a customs question into a customs offence, independently of whether the goods themselves were legal.
How we sourced this — and what we could not confirm
This page is built from government, customs and court sources, linked at the bottom. We could not open every primary statute directly, so treat section numbers and rates as a starting point for your own check rather than the last word. Customs rules and criminal statutes both change; the date on a source matters. If you find something here that is out of date or wrong, tell us and we will correct it and say so — that is the standard we hold vendors to, so it applies to us first.

United States No federal ban on adult-form dolls — but the $800 duty-free allowance every other guide still quotes was abolished in August 2025.
Canada Legal unless classified as obscene under Tariff Item 9899.00.00 — and the CAD 20 threshold that guides routinely miss means China-origin shipments are always taxable.

## Is it legal to import a sex doll into Canada?
URL: https://thedollscout.com/importing/canada

Importing / Canada
Is it legal to import an adult doll into Canada?
Legal unless classified as obscene under Tariff Item 9899.00.00 — and the CAD 20 threshold that guides routinely miss means China-origin shipments are always taxable. Duty and import-tax treatment is set out below with its source. Childlike dolls are prohibited regardless, with serious criminal penalties. Verify with customs in Canada before ordering; this is not legal advice.
General information for adult buyers, not legal advice. Rules change — verify current requirements with Canada customs before ordering.
Status: Adult-form dolls are not a prohibited category. Importation is lawful for a private adult unless the goods fall within Tariff Item 9899.00.00, which bars obscene material and child pornography. CBSA Memorandum D9-1-1 sets out how that classification is made, and notably defines “sex” for these purposes to include illustrations and animation — which is the doctrinal route by which a three-dimensional object can be brought within the item at all.
What will you pay in tax and duty?
The threshold that matters is not the one usually quoted. Under CUSMA, courier shipments from the US or Mexico are duty-free below CAD 150 and tax-free below CAD 40. For courier shipments from anywhere else — including China, where nearly every doll ships from — the threshold is CAD 20 for both duty and tax , which in practice means everything is assessable. CBSA also does not permit splitting an order across shipments to stay under a threshold, so a doll plus accessories counts as one value. Shipments above CAD 3,300 fall outside the simplified Low Value Shipment programme and need a standard commercial entry, which several premium dolls will exceed.
What does customs actually do with these shipments?
CBSA can detain and seize goods it believes fall under 9899.00.00, with the determination procedure — and the redetermination route — set out in Memorandum D9-1-17. One genuinely useful mechanism almost no other guide mentions: where admissibility is genuinely uncertain, an importer can submit a sample in advance to CBSA’s Prohibited Importations Unit. Retailers and practitioners report that officers assess appearance discretionarily on height, proportions and facial features; that is consistent with the published framework but it is not itself a CBSA statement, so we flag it as reported rather than official.
What is prohibited regardless of anything else?
Prohibited via Tariff Item 9899.00.00 and Criminal Code s. 163.1. The leading matter is R. v. Harrisson in the Newfoundland and Labrador Provincial Court, believed to be Canada’s first trial on child-pornography charges involving a doll: the doll was intercepted by CBSA at the border, the judge found that it was child pornography, but acquitted in June 2019 because the Crown had not proved the accused intended to buy a doll resembling a child. That is a trial-level decision on knowledge and intent; we found no appellate authority, so the point should be treated as unsettled above the trial level rather than as decided law.
DollScout exclusively covers adult-form products. We refuse to review, link to, or earn commission on any product with a childlike appearance, and we drop vendors that stock them.
Practical notes for buyers
The CAD 20 versus CAD 150 distinction is the most common error in Canadian doll guides. The CUSMA numbers only apply to goods originating in the US or Mexico.
Order-splitting is expressly not permitted. Value must reflect the whole order even if items ship separately.
The advance-sample route to the Prohibited Importations Unit exists if you genuinely cannot tell whether an item is admissible.
Interception happens at the border, not in the home. In the Harrisson matter the doll was caught in transit.
How we sourced this — and what we could not confirm
This page is built from government, customs and court sources, linked at the bottom. We could not open every primary statute directly, so treat section numbers and rates as a starting point for your own check rather than the last word. Not verified here: GST and HST rates, the Canada Post handling fee, the separate postal de minimis, and the Canadian tariff classification and duty rate for dolls. Customs rules and criminal statutes both change; the date on a source matters. If you find something here that is out of date or wrong, tell us and we will correct it and say so — that is the standard we hold vendors to, so it applies to us first.
Whatever your destination: the shipping and privacy guide covers what the crate looks like, what your card statement says, and what to do if a shipment arrives damaged. The True Cost Calculator folds import tax into your real first-year total.

Germany Adult-form dolls fine. Childlike dolls are criminal to merely possess — and the €150 duty-free threshold was abolished on 1 July 2026.
Japan Legal, and the home of the industry's premium manufacturers — but Japan is the one country where childlike dolls are also legal, which is a trap for foreign buyers.

## Is it legal to import a sex doll into Germany?
URL: https://thedollscout.com/importing/germany

Importing / Germany
Is it legal to import an adult doll into Germany?
Adult-form dolls fine. Childlike dolls are criminal to merely possess — and the €150 duty-free threshold was abolished on 1 July 2026. Duty and import-tax treatment is set out below with its source. Childlike dolls are prohibited regardless, with serious criminal penalties. Verify with customs in Germany before ordering; this is not legal advice.
General information for adult buyers, not legal advice. Rules change — verify current requirements with Germany customs before ordering.
Status: Adult-form dolls are lawful to import for private use. Germany is, however, one of the strictest jurisdictions on the childlike variant, and that prohibition was confirmed as constitutional in May 2026, so it is now settled law rather than a contested provision.
What will you pay in tax and duty?
This changed very recently. The €150 customs duty-free threshold was abolished with effect from 1 July 2026. Consignments up to €150 now attract a flat €3 customs charge per tariff position on the declaration, and import VAT at 19% applies on top, calculated on customs value plus duty plus freight and insurance. Dolls almost always sit well above €150, so they fall outside the flat-rate band entirely and clear under the normal tariff — full third-country duty plus 19% import VAT. The carrier normally advances the charges and bills you.
What does customs actually do with these shipments?
The documented sequence for a doll with childlike features is: parcel inspected and seized by Zoll at import, referral to the public prosecutor, who must investigate on its own motion, and confiscation and destruction of the item on conviction. How Zoll draws the adult/child line in practice — on height, proportions or facial morphology — is not published, and that ambiguity is the real risk for a lawful buyer of a petite adult doll.
What is prohibited regardless of anything else?
Criminal, including simple possession. Section 184l of the Criminal Code, in force since 1 July 2021, punishes acquisition, possession and bringing such a doll into or through Germany with up to three years, and commercial manufacture, trade or import with up to five. It expressly covers replicas of a child’s body part, so torsos are in scope, not only whole dolls. In May 2026 the Federal Constitutional Court rejected challenges to the provision, holding the interference justified.
DollScout exclusively covers adult-form products. We refuse to review, link to, or earn commission on any product with a childlike appearance, and we drop vendors that stock them.
Practical notes for buyers
Germany criminalises possession, not just import. That is stricter than the UK position and catches buyers who assume a delivered parcel is the end of the matter.
Torsos and body-part replicas are covered. Buying a part rather than a whole doll is not a workaround.
Any guide quoting a €150 duty-free allowance is out of date as of 1 July 2026.
How we sourced this — and what we could not confirm
This page is built from government, customs and court sources, linked at the bottom. We could not open every primary statute directly, so treat section numbers and rates as a starting point for your own check rather than the last word. Not verified here: the EU-level instrument behind the threshold change and whether it applies identically in other member states, and the tariff classification for dolls. Customs rules and criminal statutes both change; the date on a source matters. If you find something here that is out of date or wrong, tell us and we will correct it and say so — that is the standard we hold vendors to, so it applies to us first.

## Is it legal to import a sex doll into Japan?
URL: https://thedollscout.com/importing/japan

Importing / Japan
Is it legal to import an adult doll into Japan?
Legal, and the home of the industry's premium manufacturers — but Japan is the one country where childlike dolls are also legal, which is a trap for foreign buyers. Duty and import-tax treatment is set out below with its source. Childlike dolls are prohibited regardless, with serious criminal penalties. Verify with customs in Japan before ordering; this is not legal advice.
General information for adult buyers, not legal advice. Rules change — verify current requirements with Japan customs before ordering.
Status: Legal for a private adult. Japan is the world’s largest producer of high-end adult dolls and they are manufactured and retailed openly domestically. Customs Act Article 69-11 bars importing articles that may harm public safety or morals, and Penal Code Article 175 criminalises distributing, selling or publicly displaying obscene objects — but not private possession or private use.
What will you pay in tax and duty?
Consumption tax is 10%. Goods with a total customs value at or below ¥10,000 are exempt from both duty and consumption tax, but a doll will comfortably exceed that, so expect 10% plus any applicable duty. Note that the low-value exemption is slated for withdrawal, with overseas suppliers required to register and collect Japanese consumption tax from April 2028 — which matters little for this category, but does date any guide written before then.
What does customs actually do with these shipments?
We found no enforcement case against an adult-form doll and no source establishing that Japan Customs has ever detained one on grounds of anatomical realism. Given that such dolls are openly made and sold inside Japan, the practical risk to a private importer appears very low — but that is an observation about practice, not a legal guarantee.
What is prohibited regardless of anything else?
Japan is the major international outlier: childlike dolls are legal to manufacture, sell and possess there. Japan’s 2014 ban on possession of child sexual abuse material covers photographic depictions of real children and does not extend to manga, anime or dolls. Legislative attempts to ban childlike dolls have repeatedly failed.
DollScout exclusively covers adult-form products. We refuse to review, link to, or earn commission on any product with a childlike appearance, and we drop vendors that stock them.
Practical notes for buyers
Japanese legality does not travel, and this is the single most dangerous asymmetry in this whole subject. A product that is lawful to buy in Japan can be a serious criminal offence the moment it crosses into Australia, the UK, Germany, Canada, South Korea or several US states. If you are importing from a Japanese seller, the law that binds you is the law of your own destination.
DollScout covers adult-form products only , in every market, including this one.
How we sourced this — and what we could not confirm
This page is built from government, customs and court sources, linked at the bottom. We could not open every primary statute directly, so treat section numbers and rates as a starting point for your own check rather than the last word. Not verified here: the duty rate for dolls, Japan Customs practice on anatomical realism, and the reported convention of valuing personal imports at a fraction of overseas retail. Customs rules and criminal statutes both change; the date on a source matters. If you find something here that is out of date or wrong, tell us and we will correct it and say so — that is the standard we hold vendors to, so it applies to us first.

## Is it legal to import a sex doll into Malaysia?
URL: https://thedollscout.com/importing/malaysia

Importing / Malaysia
Is it legal to import an adult doll into Malaysia?
Treat as prohibited. Enforcement is active and seizures are routine — our advice is not to attempt import. Duty and import-tax treatment is set out below with its source. Childlike dolls are prohibited regardless, with serious criminal penalties. Verify with customs in Malaysia before ordering; this is not legal advice.
General information for adult buyers, not legal advice. Rules change — verify current requirements with Malaysia customs before ordering.
Status: High legal risk; treat as effectively prohibited. Penal Code section 292 covers sale, hire, distribution, public exhibition, circulation and importation of obscene objects, and Malaysian authorities routinely classify adult products under it. The Customs Act 1967 empowers prohibition orders whose schedules list indecent and obscene articles, and the Printing Presses and Publications Act is also used as an enforcement hook. “Obscene” is not statutorily defined, which cuts both ways: there is no bright-line ban on dolls specifically, but there is also no safe harbour for an importer. A full-size doll is conspicuous and hard to characterise as anything else.
What will you pay in tax and duty?
Largely academic given the legal position. For completeness: a 10% sales tax applies to low-value goods at or below RM500 sold online and imported by land, sea or air, effective 1 January 2024, with sellers registering above an annual sales threshold; goods above RM500 attract normal import duty and sales tax at the border.
What does customs actually do with these shipments?
High seizure risk, and this is not theoretical. The Home Ministry seized 2,295 units of adult products worth roughly RM70,000 in raids across Johor, Sarawak, Penang and Perak between mid-January and early February 2024, investigated under the publications legislation and Penal Code section 292. Selangor Customs seized contraband worth over RM700,000 including adult products in June 2024.
What is prohibited regardless of anything else?
Prohibited, as everywhere else on this site. Given that adult products themselves are treated as obscene objects here, a childlike doll compounds an already serious position.
DollScout exclusively covers adult-form products. We refuse to review, link to, or earn commission on any product with a childlike appearance, and we drop vendors that stock them.
Practical notes for buyers
Our advice for Malaysian readers is not to attempt an import. Seizure is the likely outcome and criminal exposure under section 292 and the publications legislation is real. This is one of two destinations on this site where we say plainly: do not buy.

## Is it legal to import a sex doll into New Zealand?
URL: https://thedollscout.com/importing/new-zealand

Importing / New Zealand
Is it legal to import an adult doll into New Zealand?
Lawful in principle, but the seizure standard is broader and vaguer than Australia's — read before ordering. Duty and import-tax treatment is set out below with its source. Childlike dolls are prohibited regardless, with serious criminal penalties. Verify with customs in New Zealand before ordering; this is not legal advice.
General information for adult buyers, not legal advice. Rules change — verify current requirements with New Zealand customs before ordering.
Status: Adult-form dolls are lawful in principle, but New Zealand's framing deserves more caution than Australia's. There is no doll-specific statute. Instead, section 95 of the Customs and Excise Act 2018 prohibits importing objectionable publications and other indecent or obscene articles, and New Zealand Customs' own public guidance warns that bringing in "sex toys or dolls that are considered to be indecent or obscene" can result in seizure and prosecution. That wording is not limited to childlike dolls, and the assessment sits with Customs. Every documented seizure we found involved childlike features, and we found no confirmed case of a genuinely adult-form doll being seized — but the guidance permits it, so do not treat the position as settled.
What will you pay in tax and duty?
GST is 15%. The low-value threshold is NZD 1,000 per consignment, measured on the price paid excluding transport, insurance, GST and duty. Since 1 December 2019, Customs does not collect GST or duty at the border on consignments at or below that value; instead, offshore suppliers exceeding NZD 60,000 in annual New Zealand consumer sales must register and charge 15% at checkout. Above NZD 1,000 — or where Customs lacks evidence GST was paid — Customs collects at the border and issues a demand notice before release. From 1 April 2026 a per-consignment Goods Management Levy also applies, including to low-value imports, at roughly NZD 2.21 by air or NZD 2.09 by sea plus GST.
What does customs actually do with these shipments?
New Zealand seizes fewer dolls than Australia, and Customs has publicly said this is because its powers are narrower — it is limited to full-unit dolls where Australia and the UK also seize parts, and it has lobbied for stronger law. Reported figures put the total at roughly seven border seizures and four post-border seizures of full-unit dolls since 2017. Penalty exposure is serious: importing objectionable publications carries up to 14 years, and possession of an item classified objectionable carries up to 10 years.
What is prohibited regardless of anything else?
Prohibited, by an indirect route. Customs seizes the item under the Customs and Excise Act 2018, the Classification Office then classifies it as objectionable under the Films, Videos, and Publications Classification Act 1993, and possession of a classified objectionable item becomes an offence carrying up to 10 years. A 2019 Timaru case followed exactly this sequence and produced an 18-month sentence.
DollScout exclusively covers adult-form products. We refuse to review, link to, or earn commission on any product with a childlike appearance, and we drop vendors that stock them.
Practical notes for buyers
The vague standard is the risk here. Australia tells you plainly that childlike dolls are prohibited. New Zealand tells you that dolls considered indecent or obscene may be seized, and leaves the judgement to Customs. Buy clearly adult-proportioned, and keep the specification sheet.
Customs has publicly identified evasion tactics — shipping in parts, fitting adult-sized busts, and labelling items as petite adult figures — which is precisely why small-stature adult dolls draw attention.
Most full-size dolls exceed NZD 1,000 , so expect border assessment rather than checkout GST, plus the new per-consignment levy from April 2026.
Older sources citing the Customs and Excise Act 1996 are out of date. That Act was repealed and replaced by the 2018 Act.

Customs rules and criminal statutes both change; the date on a source matters. ## Is it legal to import a sex doll into Singapore?
URL: https://thedollscout.com/importing/singapore

Importing / Singapore
Is it legal to import an adult doll into Singapore?
Not on any prohibited list and no statute bans it — but an officer can still classify it as an obscene article. A grey zone, not a safe harbour. Duty and import-tax treatment is set out below with its source. Childlike dolls are prohibited regardless, with serious criminal penalties. Verify with customs in Singapore before ordering; this is not legal advice.
General information for adult buyers, not legal advice. Rules change — verify current requirements with Singapore customs before ordering.
Status: A plain adult doll imported for genuine personal use is most likely not prohibited, but this is a grey zone rather than a safe harbour. Penal Code section 292 criminalises importing an obscene object for the purposes of sale, hire, distribution, public exhibition or circulation — personal use sits outside that purpose element. Singapore Customs’ prohibited list enumerates obscene articles, publications, videotapes, videodiscs and software, and does not separately name dolls. What remains is officer discretion at inspection. That adult products are sold openly in Singapore retail suggests the discretion is not exercised aggressively, but it exists.
What will you pay in tax and duty?
GST is 9%, raised from 8% on 1 January 2024. Singapore levies customs duty on only four categories — liquor, tobacco, motor vehicles and petroleum — so a doll attracts no duty. The low-value goods threshold is S$400 CIF for goods arriving by air or post. A common misstatement is that the S$400 relief was simply removed in 2023; what actually happened is narrower. From 1 January 2023 the Overseas Vendor Registration regime was extended to low-value goods, so a GST-registered overseas vendor charges 9% at checkout, while import GST relief at the border still applies below S$400 where the supplier is not so registered. Goods above S$400 have always been assessed at the border. A full-size doll exceeds S$400, so the practical rule is 9% GST at the border and no duty.
What does customs actually do with these shipments?
We found no enforcement case against an adult-form doll. The exposure is officer discretion rather than a listed prohibition, which puts the risk somewhere between low and moderate.
What is prohibited regardless of anything else?
Prohibited. Law firm sources cite a Penal Code provision introduced by the Criminal Law Reform Act 2019 prohibiting possession, sale and importation of child sex dolls, defined as anatomically accurate dolls resembling a person under 16 and designed for sexual purposes. We could not open the statute to confirm the section number, so we cite the prohibition rather than a number.
DollScout exclusively covers adult-form products. We refuse to review, link to, or earn commission on any product with a childlike appearance, and we drop vendors that stock them.
Practical notes for buyers
The effective age gate here is 21, not 18. Selling or distributing an obscene object to a person under 21 is a separate offence, even though contractual majority is 18.
Do not import for resale. That falls squarely inside the purpose element that makes section 292 bite.

## Is it legal to import a sex doll into South Korea?
URL: https://thedollscout.com/importing/south-korea

Importing / South Korea
Is it legal to import an adult doll into South Korea?
Legal since the customs guideline of December 2022, reaffirmed by the Supreme Court in April 2026 — after years of seizures and litigation. Duty and import-tax treatment is set out below with its source. Childlike dolls are prohibited regardless, with serious criminal penalties. Verify with customs in South Korea before ordering; this is not legal advice.
General information for adult buyers, not legal advice. Rules change — verify current requirements with South Korea customs before ordering.
Status: Legal for adult-form dolls. Getting here took seven years of litigation. Korea Customs formerly suspended clearance of full-body dolls under Customs Act Article 234(1) as goods harming public morals. The Supreme Court ruled against that position in June 2019, holding that a realistic adult doll is not such an item, but customs continued suspending shipments and importers kept suing — and mostly winning — with more than a thousand dolls reportedly held at one point. Korea Customs formally lifted the ban on 26 December 2022 with revised Real Doll Import Clearance Guidelines, and the Supreme Court reaffirmed the position in April 2026.
What will you pay in tax and duty?
VAT is 10% on imports. The personal-use de minimis is USD 150, or USD 200 for goods of US origin under the Korea–US agreement. A doll exceeds both, so expect duty plus 10% VAT on the full value. Personal imports also require a Personal Customs Clearance Code, which you must obtain before ordering.
What does customs actually do with these shipments?
Clearance is now the norm for a standard adult doll, but three things still get shipments stopped. Youthful styling is assessed on overall appearance including height, weight, face and voice, so petite or young-faced models are the practical danger zone. Dolls made to resemble a specific identifiable person are expressly barred. And dolls with built-in electrical functions such as heating, voice or massage trigger a separate safety-certification requirement. The April 2026 ruling was explicit that customs cannot refuse clearance on external appearance alone — it must examine the purpose of import, the user, and the environment and manner of use.
What is prohibited regardless of anything else?
Prohibited. The Supreme Court held in November 2021 that a device realistically modelled on the physical appearance of a female minor treats children as sexual objects and is therefore goods harming public morals under Article 234. The 2022 customs guideline codified this, barring minor-form dolls assessed on height, weight, face and voice.
DollScout exclusively covers adult-form products. We refuse to review, link to, or earn commission on any product with a childlike appearance, and we drop vendors that stock them.
Practical notes for buyers
Get your Personal Customs Clearance Code before you order , not after the parcel arrives.
Avoid celebrity or real-person likeness commissions. Korea expressly bars them, and no other jurisdiction we looked at is as explicit.
Consider ordering without heating or voice electronics to avoid the separate safety-certification path.

We could not open every primary statute directly, so treat section numbers and rates as a starting point for your own check rather than the last word. Not verified here: the case numbers for the 2019, 2021 and 2026 Supreme Court decisions, and the duty rate for dolls. Customs rules and criminal statutes both change; the date on a source matters. If you find something here that is out of date or wrong, tell us and we will correct it and say so — that is the standard we hold vendors to, so it applies to us first.

## Is it legal to import a sex doll into Thailand?
URL: https://thedollscout.com/importing/thailand

Importing / Thailand
Is it legal to import an adult doll into Thailand?
Illegal to import, with real criminal exposure. Open sale in local markets gives a false sense of safety — the border is the chokepoint. Duty and import-tax treatment is set out below with its source. Childlike dolls are prohibited regardless, with serious criminal penalties. Verify with customs in Thailand before ordering; this is not legal advice.
General information for adult buyers, not legal advice. Rules change — verify current requirements with Thailand customs before ordering.
Status: Illegal. Criminal Code section 287 covers making, producing, possessing for trade, importing, distributing and trading in obscene objects, carrying up to three years’ imprisonment and a fine, and adult products are interpreted as obscene objects under it. Such goods are prohibited imports under the Customs Act. Reform has been proposed by more than one political party but, as far as we could establish, has not passed.
What will you pay in tax and duty?
VAT is 7%. The former THB 1,500 de minimis was first narrowed by a temporary VAT measure from July 2024 and then, according to secondary reporting, abolished from 1 January 2026, making all imported parcels assessable regardless of value. We could not confirm that final step against the Customs Department directly, so verify it if the figure matters to you — though for this category the legal position makes the tax question moot.
What does customs actually do with these shipments?
Very high seizure risk. Confiscation at the border is the reported norm, and travellers have been warned of imprisonment and fines for bringing in even small personal devices.
What is prohibited regardless of anything else?
Prohibited, and compounding an already illegal import.
DollScout exclusively covers adult-form products. We refuse to review, link to, or earn commission on any product with a childlike appearance, and we drop vendors that stock them.
Practical notes for buyers
The open sale of adult products in Thai markets is the trap. Domestic non-enforcement does not extend to the border, where customs screening is the actual chokepoint.
Our advice for Thai readers is not to import. This is the clearest do-not-buy destination on this site.

## Is it legal to import a sex doll into the United Kingdom?
URL: https://thedollscout.com/importing/united-kingdom

Importing / United Kingdom
Is it legal to import an adult doll into the United Kingdom?
No prohibition identified on adult-form dolls. Importing a childlike doll is prosecuted — though simple possession is still not an offence. We could not verify current duty figures to this page's standard, so none are published. Childlike dolls are prohibited regardless, with serious criminal penalties. Verify with customs in the United Kingdom before ordering; this is not legal advice.
General information for adult buyers, not legal advice. Rules change — verify current requirements with United Kingdom customs before ordering.
Status: We found no UK provision restricting adult-form dolls, and CPS guidance is framed entirely around childlike ones. Treat that as “no prohibition identified” rather than as affirmative permission — the border route runs through obscenity law, not a product list.
What will you pay in tax and duty?
We were not able to verify current UK import VAT mechanics, thresholds or the commodity code for this category to the standard this page requires, so we are not publishing figures. Check the current position on gov.uk before ordering. What we can say is that the German equivalent changed materially in July 2026, so any figure you find in an older guide deserves suspicion.
What does customs actually do with these shipments?
Border Force has referred roughly 230 suspected childlike dolls to police since September 2016. Reported prosecutions share a pattern worth understanding: a parcel from Hong Kong or China is intercepted at an airport, frequently declared as a “mannequin”, and the doll charge is then paired with indecent-images offences after devices are examined. Sentences have ranged from suspended terms to two years eight months.
What is prohibited regardless of anything else?
There is no offence of simple possession in England and Wales. Importation is charged as knowingly acquiring possession of goods subject to a prohibition on importing indecent or obscene articles, under s. 42 of the Customs Consolidation Act 1876 together with s. 170(1)(a) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979. The CPS test asks whether the doll was created for sexual use and has sufficient characteristics of a child that it is plainly to be looked at and used for that childlike appearance. One open thread: a Child-like Sexual Abuse Dolls (Offences) Bill exists before Parliament and we could not establish its current status, so a dedicated possession offence may now exist or be imminent. Check before relying on the possession position.
DollScout exclusively covers adult-form products. We refuse to review, link to, or earn commission on any product with a childlike appearance, and we drop vendors that stock them.
Practical notes for buyers
Mis-declaring a doll as a “mannequin” is the recurring fact pattern in UK prosecutions , and it aggravates rather than helps. Declare accurately.
A seizure triggers a wider search. In nearly every reported case the doll charge arrived alongside indecent-images charges found on devices.

## Is it legal to import a sex doll into the United States?
URL: https://thedollscout.com/importing/united-states

Importing / United States
Is it legal to import an adult doll into the United States?
No federal ban on adult-form dolls — but the $800 duty-free allowance every other guide still quotes was abolished in August 2025. Duty and import-tax treatment is set out below with its source. Childlike dolls are prohibited regardless, with serious criminal penalties. Verify with customs in the United States before ordering; this is not legal advice.
General information for adult buyers, not legal advice. Rules change — verify current requirements with United States customs before ordering.
Status: There is no federal statute prohibiting the import, sale or possession of an adult-form doll. Admissibility at the border runs through 19 U.S.C. § 1305, which bars importing articles that are “obscene or immoral” — an obscenity judgement made in the first instance by a CBP officer at the port, not a product-category rule. The honest framing is therefore “not prohibited” rather than “expressly permitted”: ordinary adult-form dolls are admitted in practice, but there is no statutory safe harbour. That Congress has repeatedly tried and failed since 2017 to ban even the childlike subset is itself evidence that no general federal ban exists.
What will you pay in tax and duty?
This is where almost every other buyer guide is now wrong. The $800 de minimis allowance is gone. Executive Order 14324 suspended duty-free de minimis treatment for all countries effective 29 August 2025; interim final rules published 24 June 2026 indefinitely suspended it for merchandise arriving by every mode other than the international postal network; and the One Big Beautiful Bill Act statutorily terminates it from 1 July 2027. In practice, a doll shipped to a US buyer today is dutiable regardless of value, requires a customs entry, and will usually attract a carrier brokerage fee on top. We deliberately do not quote a duty percentage: the tariff classification for full-size adult dolls is unsettled — CBP has classified vibrating devices under heading 9019 and a non-vibrating plastic article under 3926, and we found no ruling covering a full-size doll. Anyone importing as a business should seek a binding ruling.
What does customs actually do with these shipments?
CBP may open an international parcel without a warrant. Where § 1305 is invoked the machinery is administrative and fast: the article is seized and referred to the US Attorney, who must institute forfeiture proceedings within 14 days. We found no CBP directive addressing adult dolls specifically and no published interception statistics, so treat any claim about how often these parcels get opened as speculation. The documented risk vectors are misclassification, undervaluation, and the childlike-appearance judgement.
What is prohibited regardless of anything else?
There is no federal child-sex-doll statute. The CREEPER Act passed the House in June 2018 and died in the Senate; CREEPER 2.0 has been reintroduced in three consecutive Congresses and remains in committee. Federal exposure therefore runs through the general obscenity and customs statutes. State law is where the felonies are: Arizona, Florida, Hawaii, Kentucky, Louisiana, South Dakota and Tennessee have enacted statutes, and the Arizona, Hawaii, Kentucky and Louisiana provisions expressly reach importing — so a package crossing into those states creates state exposure independent of federal law.
DollScout exclusively covers adult-form products. We refuse to review, link to, or earn commission on any product with a childlike appearance, and we drop vendors that stock them.
Practical notes for buyers
Do not ask a seller to under-declare the value. This is the single most common piece of advice on doll forums and it is customs fraud under 19 U.S.C. § 1592. With de minimis gone the temptation is larger and so is the exposure. Declare accurately and budget for the duty.
Childlike dolls have functioned mainly as investigative tripwires. In the US cases we could find, the doll led to a search that produced child sexual abuse material charges, rather than being prosecuted as a standalone import offence. In at least one Kentucky matter the doll charge was dismissed on the ground that a doll is not a person — which is precisely why states began writing bespoke statutes.
We could not find a leading federal conviction for importing a childlike doll under § 1305. We report that as an unresolved gap, not as proof none exists.
Sales or use tax is separate from import duty and is owed on the purchase regardless. Rules vary by state.

Not verified here: the tariff classification and duty rate for full-size dolls, the current China tariff stack, and the outcome of pending Supreme Court tariff litigation that could change the duty math. Customs rules and criminal statutes both change; the date on a source matters. ## YourDoll Review: The Evidence File, From an Affiliate
URL: https://thedollscout.com/vendors/yourdoll

Home / Vendors / YourDoll
YourDoll (yourdoll.com): the evidence file
Last updated 1 August 2026 · every number sourced, or marked unverified
Read this first: we earn commission from this vendor. Links
to yourdoll.com on this site carry our referral tag, and purchases pay us.
Reviews of doll shops are routinely written by affiliates who do not tell you that.
We are telling you at the top, because the page only has value if you can
calibrate it — and because our standing promise is to publish criticism of
vendors we earn from. This page is that promise kept.
What the public record shows
Their ratings disagree with each other, and that disagreement is the
finding. A shop with one glowing score is easy to judge; a shop whose
scores span two full stars needs its evidence read, not averaged.

knoji.com

Not accredited; profile carries complaints recorded as unanswered. We could not load the BBB page directly to read it ourselves — treat this line as second-hand until you have.
bbb.org
One more data point, reported for completeness: the company has publicly
stated that a group left dozens of one-star reviews with no matching orders in
its system. We cannot verify either the reviews or the rebuttal — but it is
part of the record, and it cuts both ways: it could explain some low scores,
and it is also exactly what any shop would say about low scores.
The recurring complaints, specifically
Generic "mixed reviews" tells you nothing. The themes that repeat are
specific and worth planning around:
Photo-versus-reality gap. Buyers reporting that "the
photos of the website appear highly manipulated since the actual doll is not
even close".
Arrival condition. Dolls arriving broken, with mismatched
colour, or with missing parts.
Responsiveness after a complaint — the one that matters
most, because it decides how every other problem ends. This partly fails our
own vetting criterion 6 (a real contact surface with responsive support), and
we say so rather than quietly re-scoring it.
Why we still list them — and what neutralises the risks
We keep the listing because the largest review sample is still positive, and
because the two most common complaints have a defence that works at any vendor —
which is the same advice we give everywhere on this site:
Require factory photos of your actual doll and approve
them in writing before dispatch. This collapses the photo-gap and
arrival-condition risks into a checkpoint you control.
Pay by credit card or PayPal, never bank transfer — so a
dispute route survives if the third complaint theme (post-sale silence)
happens to you. What each payment method preserves:
the recourse checker , which carries no
affiliate links.
Film the unboxing continuously, crate to doll. That video
wins disputes.
What we could not verify
The BBB detail, as above — the page would not load for us.
Individual review authenticity, in either direction.
Warehouse and shipping-origin claims; ask "which country does my order
physically ship from?" in writing and keep the reply, per the
Scam-Check 's post-payment traps.
No score, deliberately. A one-number verdict launders all of the above into
false precision — and this vendor's whole story is that the numbers disagree.
